compute_reference: Shared synthetic compute profiles; compute accuracy is not evaluated
calibration_rule: nonnegative calibration request E2E residual divided by its TP task count; one fixed offset per collective
limitations: Single request per run; no batching or contention accuracy claim
Synthetic compute profiles are shared by every path; they are not hardware measurements
Reference and predictions share the request scheduler; this isolates communication cost calibration
All samples share the Decode communication payload; only Prefill payloads and request workloads are held out
Does not validate PD, dynamic MoE, their combination, or real GPU accuracy
